name: e1_backdoor_rounds
title: E1: training under the boosted backdoor
caption: Clean accuracy (a) and backdoor attack success rate (b) per round under the ×4 boosted backdoor (E1, three seeds). Lines are means; bands are 95 % Student-t intervals over seeds.
transform: rows study=e1, attack=backdoor, metric in {global_accuracy, backdoor_asr}, rounds 1-10; mean and ci95 columns plotted as recorded (CI clipped to [0,1])

name: backdoor_asr_by_defence
title: Backdoor success by defence, boosted vs adaptive attacker
caption: Final-round backdoor attack success rate per seed (dots) and mean (tick) for each defence. (a) Boosted backdoor, E1/E1x; (b) adaptive backdoor that scales its update to 0.95 × the published threshold, E2. The dotted line is the clean model's natural trigger response (E1, no attack).
transform: per run: backdoor_asr of the last completed round; studies e1/e1x (attack backdoor) and e2 (adaptive_backdoor); reference = mean final ASR of e1 baseline without attack

name: e3_schedule_predictability
title: E3: schedule predictability in federated training
caption: Schedule-aware adversaries (budget 2, ×4 backdoor, FedAvg without defence, three seeds). (a) Mean number of malicious clients per cohort; (b) clean accuracy. Dots are seeds, diamonds means.
transform: per run (study e3): mean of malicious_selected over rounds 1-10 and mean global_accuracy of the last three rounds

name: e3mc_exposure
title: E3-MC: compromise hit rate per schedule
caption: Share of compromised clients that end up in a cohort (N = 12, K = 4, R = 10 rounds, 200 Monte-Carlo trials). Error bars are 95 % Student-t intervals over trials; the dotted line is the random baseline K/N.
transform: rows metric=compromise_hit_rate, budgets 2 and 3; mean and ci95 columns as recorded

name: e4_sweeps
title: E4: attack-strength sweeps
caption: Attack-strength sweeps (two seeds) for FedAvg and the plaintext execution of the adaptive norm defence, which is trajectory-identical to the SPDZ2k program. Dots are seeds, lines connect means. In (b) hollow markers are runs whose model was destroyed; the line averages only runs with a usable model.
transform: per run (study e4): last-three-round mean accuracy and final-round ASR; attacks backdoor__boost{1,2,8,16} and sign_flip__str{1,2,8}

name: overhead_in_training
title: Per-round cost inside federated training
caption: Mean cost per training round without attack (E1, 2,202 parameters, K = 4, three SPDZ2k parties on one host; 3 runs × 10 rounds per configuration). The sum-only round includes about 8.5 s of per-round compilation.
transform: study e1, attack none, rounds 1-10: means of round_seconds, mpc_protocol_seconds_max and mpc_global_data_sent_mb (MB/1000)

name: benchmark_scaling
title: SPDZ2k cost vs model size
caption: Isolated SPDZ2k rounds (three local parties, K = 4) for model sizes from 1,000 to 100,000 parameters. Dots are repetitions, lines connect means; both axes are logarithmic. The cross marks the sum-only round with 250,000 parameters, which the parties' 600 s round timeout stopped.
transform: rows parties=3, mode=clip_screen, threshold=adaptive (the sum-only rows carry the same label columns); completed rows: protocol_seconds_max and global_data_sent_mb/1000; failed row marked at the timeout

name: pilot_sign_agreement
title: Pilot: sign agreement of honest and malicious updates
caption: Offline pilot on the recorded updates of 175 runs: sign agreement of each update with the majority of the other cohort members on a random 25 % coordinate subset, for cohorts with exactly one attacker. Boxes span the quartiles, whiskers 1.5 × IQR. AUC = probability that an honest update agrees more than the attacker's.
transform: rows attackers_in_cohort = 1; column sign_agree_0.25_single split by the malicious flag; AUC by pairwise comparison (ties 0.5)

name: m2_subset_types
title: M2: which coordinates the direction screen checks
caption: Direction screen with τ = 0.52 and static cohorts of four (three seeds; plaintext execution of the in-MPC algorithm). Dots are seeds, ticks means. The norm-only baseline combines M1 (seeds 101, 102) and M2b (seed 103).
transform: final-round ASR per run as recorded in the run tables (m1_summary.py)

name: p3_paired
title: P3: paired comparison of static and secret cohorts
caption: Paired evaluation (cohorts of seven, five seeds): within a seed all conditions share the same secret cohorts and secret subsets. Grey lines connect the four conditions of one seed; black ticks are means.
transform: final-round ASR per run as recorded; pivot by seed and condition

name: f1_spdz2k_framework
title: F1: final framework inside SPDZ2k
caption: Final framework executed in SPDZ2k (secure clip/screen, secret 25 % direction screen with τ = 0.52, secret MTD, cohorts of seven; three seeds). Dots are seeds, ticks means.
transform: final-round ASR and last-three-round accuracy per run as recorded

name: direction_screen_cost
title: Cost of the direction screen in SPDZ2k
caption: One SPDZ2k round of the robust program at d = 2,202 and K = 4 (three local parties), without and with the direction screen; two repetitions each (dots), bars are means. All rounds matched the reference bit for bit.
transform: party 0 protocol_seconds and global_data_sent_mb/1000 per repetition

name: sum_only_correction
title: Sum-only SPDZ2k against FedAvg before and after the scale correction
caption: (a) Accuracy trajectories of one seed-matched triple under scaled replacement: the decimal scale S = 10⁶ diverges from FedAvg, the power-of-two scale S = 2⁴⁰ coincides with it in every round. (b) Largest per-round accuracy difference to FedAvg for each of the 18 smpc_only runs (zero for every rerun).
transform: global_accuracy per round as recorded; max_abs_accuracy_difference per run (pow2_vs_fedavg.py)

name: e6_leakage
title: E6: images recoverable by a curious coordinator
caption: Analytic input read-out through the first fully connected layer of a probe MLP (E6, FedSGD, 8 trials per point): share of the target client's images recovered near-exactly from its own update (plaintext FedAvg) and from the SPDZ2k aggregate of a four-client cohort.
transform: rows attack=fc_input; share of image records with ssim >= 0.9 per (model_state, view, batch_size)
